⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. This enables better-auth's one-time-token plugin so the mobile shell can hand a system-browser sign-in back to its WebView. Today a user whose provider refuses embedded WebViews cannot sign in on mobile. A missing capability, ruled B by the maintainer, so p2.
- **Contract first:** the new public surface is declared in `packages/spec` by a `domain:spec` card or PR before the server PR goes ready. The server seat files it at claim, unless the spec lane takes it from here.
- **Human floor:** an auth boundary. The PR states how an intercepted callback is kept from being redeemed (for example, a verifier bound at start), and the maintainer reviews and merges it. Any security finding goes to the security lane, not to a public comment.

Ruling: decision card cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8X5ext5gvz9uoXDzxE3L2Ei (thread "Decide mobile sign-in session freshness") · letter A · maintainer tapped 「A · 要求会话新鲜(推荐)」 · recorded 2026-11-03T06:25Z

Tapped at 2026-11-03T06:23Z on the decision card.

**What letter A binds (PR #29766, residual risk 1 of its Acceptance notes):**
- `GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff` refuses unless the caller's session was created within about 5 minutes (a freshness check on the route; no UI).
- It also refuses a request carrying `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`, checked only when that header is present (a browser that sends no such header is not refused for its absence).
- B (an interstitial confirm page) is not wanted; C (accept) is not chosen.
- **Consequence for the mobile shell (objectstack-ai/mobile, the card that designs the shell half):** an existing Safari / Custom Tabs session is no longer enough. The shell completes a full sign-in in the system auth session every time before it opens the hand-off; an ephemeral auth session is fine.
- Work: a few lines on the hand-off route plus pins, built in PR #29766's rebase onto #29804 (spec slice #29736), before the seat's review of record. `Clause-②` unchanged by the ruling (`yes (widening)`, the route itself; the freshness rule narrows only the route this PR adds).

domain:server#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXKRzgnVvjzxaYxLUf

For repo:mobile#1 (the filer of this card, os-justin), at 2026-11-03T06:30Z: ruling A on this card (6597001931) changes the shell half of the hand-off.

- `GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff` refuses unless the caller's session was **created** within 5 minutes: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` with a "sign in again" message, the same answer as no session, so the shell needs one branch for both.
- It refuses a request that carries `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. A request with no such header, or with `none`, `same-origin` or `same-site`, hands off.
- **For the shell:** an existing Safari / Custom Tabs session is no longer enough. Complete a full sign-in in the system auth session every time before opening the hand-off. An ephemeral auth session is fine.

Server side: PR #29766 (built at 4b3e1fd5, lands after the spec slice #29804). Please carry this into the mobile card that designs the shell half (from objectstack-ai/mobile#148 item 4 / #176).
